```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(biomaRt)
library(Biostrings)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
source("step7b_check_mutations_lib.R")

theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

output_len = 15
if(output_len %%2 == 0){
  stop("peptide length should be an odd number\n")
}
```

# Read in data


## Read in all the somatic mutation data

```{r}
mutation_file = "mc3.v0.2.8.CONTROLLED.maf.gz"

mut_dat0 = fread(file.path(data_dir, mutation_file), 
                select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "NCBI_Build", "Chromosome", "Strand", 
                           "Start_Position", "End_Position", "Reference_Allele", 
                           "Tumor_Seq_Allele1", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2", 
                           "Variant_Classification", "Variant_Type", 
                           "Feature", "Feature_type", "Consequence", 
                           "HGVSc", "HGVSp_Short", "Transcript_ID"))
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

mut_dat0 = distinct(mut_dat0)
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

table(mut_dat0$Strand)
table(mut_dat0$Variant_Type)
```

## Load somatic mutations and peptide data

These are the mutations that appear at least 5 times in TCG data. 

Check the format of each type of mutations. Remove three small groups "Nonstop_Mutation", "Splice_Site", and "Translation_Start_Site".

```{r}
mut_data = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step7_mutations.tsv"))
dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

table(mut_data$Variant_Classification, mut_data$Variant_Type)
table(mut_data$Variant_Classification, mut_data$group)

mut_class = unique(mut_data$Variant_Classification)

for(mc1 in mut_class){
  mut1 = mut_data[Variant_Classification == mc1, 
                  .(Variant_Classification, Tumor_Seq_Allele1, 
                    Tumor_Seq_Allele2, Strand, HGVSc, HGVSp_Short)]
  print(mc1)
  print(mut1[1:min(5, nrow(mut1)),])
}

class2rm = c("Nonstop_Mutation", "Splice_Site", "Translation_Start_Site")
mut_data = mut_data[-which(mut_data$Variant_Classification %in% class2rm),]
dim(mut_data)
```

## Check the size of reference and alternative alleles.

Filter out one mutation that is a huge deletion

```{r}
nchar_A1 = nchar(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele1)
nchar_A2 = nchar(mut_data$Tumor_Seq_Allele2)

table(nchar_A1)
table(nchar_A2)

tapply(nchar_A1, mut_data$Variant_Classification, table)

mut_data = mut_data[which(nchar_A1 < 10000),]
dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]
```

## Examine each type of somatic mutations

df_counts is a data.frame to save the total count of each type of mutations. The numbers will be updated slightly after some filtering in the following steps.

```{r}
table(mut_data$Variant_Classification)
variant_classifications = unique(mut_data$Variant_Classification)

mut_dat0 = mut_dat0[mut_dat0$Variant_Classification %in% variant_classifications,]
dim(mut_dat0)

c1 = chisq.test(mut_data$Variant_Classification, mut_data$group)
round(c1$expected)
c1$observed

round(c1$observed/c1$expected, 2)
c1$p.value

table(mut_data$Variant_Classification, mut_data$Variant_Type)
df_counts = data.table(Variant_Classification = 
                         unique(mut_data$Variant_Classification))
df_counts[,n_all := 0]
df_counts[,n_mut5_no := 0]
df_counts[,n_mut5_weak := 0]
df_counts[,n_mut5_strong := 0]
```

### Missense Mutation

```{r fig.width=8.4, fig.height=2.5}
mut_data1 = mut_data[Variant_Classification == "Missense_Mutation",]
dim(mut_data1)
mut_data1[1:2,]

table(mut_data1$Variant_Type)
table(nchar(mut_data1$Tumor_Seq_Allele1))
table(nchar(mut_data1$Tumor_Seq_Allele2))

mut1_all = mut_dat0[Variant_Classification == "Missense_Mutation" & 
                      Variant_Type == "SNP",]
dim(mut1_all)
table(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele1))
table(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2))

mut1_all = mut1_all[HGVSp_Short != ".",]
dim(mut1_all)

# check the expected pattern: c.608C>T
is_pattern = str_detect(mut_data1$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.)\\d{1,10}[A|C|G|T]>[A|C|G|T]")
stopifnot(all(is_pattern))

is_pattern = str_detect(mut1_all$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.)\\d{1,10}[A|C|G|T]>[A|C|G|T]")
table(is_pattern)
mut1_all = mut1_all[is_pattern,]

# check the expected pattern: p.A203V
is_pattern = str_detect(mut_data1$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]\\d{1,10}[A-Z]")
stopifnot(all(is_pattern))

is_pattern = str_detect(mut1_all$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]\\d{1,10}[A-Z]")
table(is_pattern)
mut1_all[!is_pattern,][1:2,]
mut1_all = mut1_all[is_pattern,]

df_counts = update_df_count(df_counts, mut1_all, mut_data1, "Missense_Mutation")

DNA_ref = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,10})[A|C|G|T]")
DNA_mut = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,10}[A|C|G|T]>)[A|C|G|T]")

DNA_ref_all = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,10})[A|C|G|T]")
DNA_mut_all = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.\\d{1,10}[A|C|G|T]>)[A|C|G|T]")

g1_list = get_DNA_ref_mut_plot(DNA_ref_all, DNA_mut_all, 
                               mut_data1, DNA_ref, DNA_mut, 
                               freq_upper_limit = 0.55)

ggarrange(plotlist=g1_list, nrow=1, ncol=4, legend = "top", 
          common.legend = TRUE)
```

### Missense Mutation, AA frequency

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})[A-Z]")

AA_ref_all  = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
AA_mut_all  = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})[A-Z]")

plot_AA_ref_mut_all(AA_ref_all, AA_mut_all)

dfa = plot_AA_ref_mut(AA_ref_all, AA_mut_all, mut_data1, AA_ref, AA_mut)

dim(dfa)
summary(dfa$Ratio)
0.05/nrow(dfa)
dfa[which(dfa$Ratio > 1.5 & dfa$pvalue < 0.05/nrow(dfa)),]
```

### Missense Mutation: illustrate over-reprented mutations 

The mutations that are much more abundant among those that appear in 5 or more cancer patients. 

```{r fig.width=4.5, fig.height=2.5}
df_sub = dfa[which(dfa$Ratio > 1.5 & dfa$pvalue < 0.05/nrow(dfa)),]
plot_AA_prop_all_vs_strong(df_sub)
plot_AA_prop_all_vs_public(df_sub)
```

### Frame_Shift_Del

```{r fig.width=4.5, fig.height=3}
mut_data1 = mut_data[Variant_Classification == "Frame_Shift_Del",]
dim(mut_data1)
mut_data1[1:2,]

table(mut_data1$Variant_Type)
table(nchar(mut_data1$Tumor_Seq_Allele1))
table(mut_data1$Tumor_Seq_Allele2)

mut1_all = mut_dat0[Variant_Classification == "Frame_Shift_Del" & 
                      Variant_Type == "DEL",]
dim(mut1_all)
summary(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele1))
summary(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2))

table(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele1) > 1)
table(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2) > 1)

ww2  = which(nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2) == 2)
mut1_all[ww2[1:2],]

mut1_all = mut1_all[nchar(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2) == 1,]
table(mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2)
mut1_all = mut1_all[mut1_all$Tumor_Seq_Allele2 == "-",]
dim(mut1_all)
mut1_all[1:2,]

# check the expected pattern: c.472delA or c.1413_1414delTC
is_pattern = str_detect(mut_data1$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.)[\\d|_]{1,20}del[A|C|G|T]+")
stopifnot(all(is_pattern))

is_pattern = str_detect(mut1_all$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.)[\\d|_]{1,20}del[A|C|G|T]+")
table(is_pattern)
mut1_all = mut1_all[is_pattern,]

# check the expected pattern: p.R158Gfs*6 or p.L56*
protein_pt = "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]\\d{1,10}[A-Z]fs\\*\\d+|(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]\\d{1,10}\\*"
is_pattern = str_detect(mut_data1$HGVSp_Short, protein_pt)
table(is_pattern)
mut_data1[!is_pattern,]
mut_data1 = mut_data1[is_pattern,]

is_pattern = str_detect(mut1_all$HGVSp_Short, protein_pt)
table(is_pattern)
mut1_all[!is_pattern,][1:2,]
mut1_all = mut1_all[is_pattern,]

df_counts = update_df_count(df_counts, mut1_all, mut_data1, "Frame_Shift_Del")

DNA_ref = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.[\\d|_]{1,20}del)[A|C|G|T]+")
DNA_ref_all = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSc, "(?<=c\\.[\\d|_]{1,20}del)[A|C|G|T]+")

table(DNA_ref)
DNA_ref[nchar(DNA_ref) > 1] = "multi"
DNA_ref_all[nchar(DNA_ref_all) > 1] = "multi"

DNA_ref = factor(DNA_ref, levels = c("A", "C", "G", "T", "multi"))
DNA_ref_all = factor(DNA_ref_all, levels = c("A", "C", "G", "T", "multi"))

df0 = as.data.frame(table(DNA_ref_all)/length(DNA_ref_all))
df0$type = "all"
names(df0)[1] = "DNA_ref"

dfd = df0
for(grp1 in c("No", "Weak", "Strong")){
  w1 = which(mut_data1$group == grp1)
  df1 = as.data.frame(table(DNA_ref[w1])/length(DNA_ref[w1]))
  names(df1)[1] = "DNA_ref"
  df1$type = grp1
  dfd = rbind(dfd, df1)
}

dfd$type = factor(dfd$type, levels = c("all", "No", "Weak", "Strong"))
ggplot(dfd, aes(x = DNA_ref, y = Freq, fill = type)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Reference allele", y = "Proportion", fill = "") +
  ggtitle("Prop. of frame shift del.") + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")
```

### Frame_Shift_Del, check the frequency in terms AA.

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=5.2}
protein_pt = "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]\\d{1,10}[A-Z]fs\\*\\d+|(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]\\d{1,10}\\*"

AA_ref  = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
AA_mut  = str_extract(mut_data1$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})\\D+")

AA_ref_all  = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.)[A-Z]")
AA_mut_all  = str_extract(mut1_all$HGVSp_Short, "(?<=p\\.[A-Z]\\d{1,10})\\D+")

table(AA_ref)
table(AA_mut)
table(AA_ref_all)
table(AA_mut_all)

AA_mut = gsub("fs*", "", AA_mut, fixed = TRUE)
AA_mut_all = gsub("fs*", "", AA_mut_all, fixed = TRUE)

plot_AA_ref_mut_all(AA_ref_all, AA_mut_all)

dfa = plot_AA_ref_mut(AA_ref_all, AA_mut_all, mut_data1, AA_ref, AA_mut)

dim(dfa)
summary(dfa$Ratio)
0.05/nrow(dfa)
dfa[which(dfa$Ratio > 1.5 & dfa$pvalue < 0.05/nrow(dfa)),]
```

### Frame_Shift_Del, check the frequency in terms AA.

```{r fig.width=3.4, fig.height=2.5}
df_sub = dfa[which(dfa$Ratio > 1.5 & dfa$pvalue < 0.05/nrow(dfa)),]
plot_AA_prop_all_vs_strong(df_sub)
plot_AA_prop_all_vs_public(df_sub)
```

mut_data1 = mut_data[Variant_Classification == "In_Frame_Del",]
dim(mut_data1)
mut_data1[1:2,]

### Check mutation frequency.

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=2.5}
df_counts

n_mut5 = data.matrix(df_counts[,-(1:2)])
rownames(n_mut5) = df_counts$Variant_Classification
n_mut5

c1 = chisq.test(n_mut5)
round(c1$expected)
c1$observed

round(c1$observed/c1$expected, 2)
c1$p.value


all_vs_strong = data.matrix(df_counts[,c(2,5)])
rownames(all_vs_strong) = df_counts$Variant_Classification
all_vs_strong[,"n_all"] = all_vs_strong[,"n_all"] - all_vs_strong[,"n_mut5_strong"]

c1 = chisq.test(all_vs_strong)
round(c1$expected)
c1$observed

round(c1$observed/c1$expected, 2)
c1$p.value
```
